summary: The health manager retries a dead Companion latched in human_required at most once per HEALTH_LATCHED_RETRY_S (900 s) instead of refusing every restart until a human acts; the human escalation stays open, a live Companion keeps the latch and other services are unchanged.
reason: restart_gate refuses every restart in human_required until 10 minutes of verified stability, which a stopped process can never reach: the Companion (and the Claw bridge through it) stayed down until a manual restart on the S24 on 03/11 at 19:03 after a reboot and again around 22:05 after a deploy day.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-health-restart-escalation.py
tests.evidence: 10 tests; the new one fails without the change: one retry at t0, none at t0+300 s, one at t0+900 s, none while the process runs, none for another latched service, escalation still open, no rollback. Registered in ci.yml.

tests.name: test-health-boot-reset.py, test-health-deploy-lock.py, test-health-gateway-fallback-owner.py, test-health-hysteresis.py, test-health-qa-queue.py, test-health-resource-policy.py, test-health-verdict-f5.py, test-health-verdict.py, test-immune-action.py, test-ci-registration.py
tests.evidence: Every health-manager and immune suite green on this head.

capabilities.reason: Supervision behaviour only; no route, action or capability (NO_CAPABILITY).

architecture.reason: Same restart gate, lease and state files of the existing health manager; one more state file per service, no new store, scheduler or daemon.

evidence: The Claw bridge runs inside the Companion: it becomes reachable again without a manual restart; no MCP tool or schema touched.

limitations: A second lead (deployment mode seen at 21:51 on 03/11 while the deploy process was gone) is not proven: on 04/11 09:08 no process held companion-deploy.lock.
The retry restarts only an absent Companion; a live but unhealthy Companion still follows the latch.
rollback: Revert this commit (strict latch again), or set HEALTH_LATCHED_RETRY_S to a very large value.
